title: feat(forms): a public form binds to the organizations it is published to (ADR-0138 D5)
body:
Fixes #25574

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Ruling-ref: 6377889413

Implements ADR-0138 D5 as ruling B on #25447 (`6377889413`, the governing record per reconciliation `6377958424`) decides it, verbatim: 「公共表单发布时绑定一个组织（URL 携带组织，授予通道按 #23224 解析 D4 的方式解析它），访客锚点的绑定在该组织下求值，ADR-0138 其余不变」. One cross-domain PR under triage answer A (`6382869387`); the ADR-0138 dated note rides its own Tier H docs PR (`claude/issue-25574-adr-0138-d5-note`), so no `docs/adr/**` path is in this diff.

## What changes

- **The binding (spec).** `SharingConfigSchema` (`packages/spec/src/ui/sharing.zod.ts`, carried by `FormViewSchema.sharing`, the one declaration of a form's public publication) gains `organizations`: a non-empty list of organization slugs the form is published to. `organization` / `orgs` / `tenants` are refused and pointed at it. `anonymousFormIntakeOrganizations(sharing)` (`packages/spec/src/ui/anonymous-form-intake.ts`, re-exported by `@objectstack/metadata-core`) reads it, beside the candidates half of the intake rule.
- **The decision (core).** `resolvePublicFormOrganization` (`packages/core/src/security/public-form-organization.ts`, beside `guest-organization.ts`): unbound (the form lists none and the link names none: ADR-0138 D4 decides, unchanged), bound (the link names a listed slug and exactly one organization carries it), or refuse (every other case). The organization id is the server's own read of the listed slug, as the system; the client only selects among the slugs the author published to (D4 item 1).
- **The doors (rest).** Both `GET /forms/:slug` and `POST /forms/:slug/submit` read `?organization=SLUG` once, in `resolveFormBySlug`. A refusal is answered exactly as an unpublished form, `404 FORM_NOT_FOUND`, so an anonymous caller learns nothing about which organizations exist or which a form lists. On a bound link the submit context carries `tenantId` = that organization: the engine's write target, so the row lands there and its autonumber counts there. The form grant (`publicFormGrant`, `permissions: ['guest_portal']`) is unchanged.
- **The posture predicate (metadata-core).** `anonymousFormIntakeUnavailability` takes the form's binding as an optional fourth argument: a bound form is never withheld on a walled posture, because the reason it states (an anonymous submission carries no organization) does not hold. Omitted, the form is judged unbound, which fails closed. Its three readers pass it: the door, the administrator's read of the view (`rest-server.ts`) and the save/publish advisory (`metadata-protocol` `runtime-authoring-gate.ts`), so none of them states that a bound form is not offered.
- **Unchanged.** The unbound form keeps D4 exactly: no URL change, the engine derives the single organization or refuses. ADR-0138's doors, grants channel and anonymous default-deny are untouched.

## Booted measurement (the card's acceptance)

`examples/app-showcase`, built at this branch, booted with `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL=admin@objectos.ai OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 38517` (the multi-organization runtime present, the wall standing). Measurement-only edits, not committed: `showcase_inquiry` gained `inquiry_number: Field.autonumber({ autonumberFormat: 'INQ-{0000}' })`, and the `contact-us` form's `sharing` gained `organizations: ['acme', 'globex']`. Signed in as the seeded admin, three organizations were created through `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/create`: `acme`, `globex` (listed) and `initech` (not listed). ## Tests

Read at head `c990aed37` (after merging `origin/main`); the gate reconciliation below was taken on that tree.


- `packages/spec`: `src/ui/sharing.test.ts`, `src/ui/anonymous-form-intake.test.ts` (2 files, 46 tests); `src/ui` 153 files / 5623 tests passed.
- `packages/core`: new `src/security/public-form-organization.test.ts` (15 tests: unbound, bound per slug, each refusal reason with "the database is never asked", unknown and duplicated slug, exact match, outage propagates); `src/security` 55 files / 1118 tests passed.
- `packages/metadata-core`: `anonymous-form-intake.test.ts` (the bound form is available on both walled postures without reading the object; the binding omitted fails closed); package 19 files / 800 tests passed.
- `packages/metadata-protocol`: package 263 files / 21473 tests passed (3 files skipped).
- `packages/rest`: new `src/public-form-organization.test.ts` (15 tests: each listed organization's link writes `tenantId` = that organization on `isolated` and `single`; every refused link equals the unpublished form's answer byte for byte with nothing written and no organization read; the admin read raises no warning for a bound form; the unbound form keeps D4 and refuses a link naming an organization). Package 321 files / 6412 tests passed; after merging `origin/main` (which brought #25620's `public-form-section-i18n.test.ts` pin), the nine `public-form*` files 127/127 passed.
- `packages/qa/dogfood`: no public-form dogfood test reads `sharing.organizations`; not run locally, declared to CI.

- Ablation (each leg through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to a byte-identical blob): deleting the door's `tenantId` threading turns 4 of 15 rest tests red; deleting the door's refusal return turns 7 of 15 red.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `c990aed37` derived 119 commands; all 119 run, each exit captured before any pipe, all exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles: "119 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 119 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". One needed a second run: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 because this shallow clone could not reach its pinned positive-control commit; after fetching that one commit it exited 0. `packages/spec` `check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date after the merge. `check:dev-prereqs` (local only): exit 0. The full farm is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **Slug, not id.** The binding names organization slugs: they are what a public notice link carries and what an administrator sees (`sys_organization.highlightFields`), and they are globally unique. An organization whose slug changes stops matching its links, which fails closed (404).
- **The console page.** The REST door is the contract. `/_console/f/:slug` (objectui) must forward `?organization=` to the API for a bound form to render there; that is objectui's side and not in this repository.
- **No closed query set on these two routes.** The doors now read `req.query.organization`; they are existing routes, and converting them to `refuseUnknownQueryParams` would be a narrowing outside this card. An unbound form's link that names an organization is refused rather than ignored, so a stray parameter cannot land a row in an organization the link did not ask for.
- **The guest anchor.** The form doors run under the form grant, not the D3 guest envelope; on a bound link every set resolution and the result masker run under the bound organization because the context carries it. No guest anchor binding is read at these doors, before or after.
- **Mechanism readings.** The multi-organization refusal a form submission met was not `guest-organization.ts` (that is the class 4/5 endpoint doors' refusal, unchanged here) but two others: on a walled posture, the door's 404 from `anonymousFormIntakeUnavailability`; on `single` with several organizations, the engine's `SystemWriteOrganizationRequiredError` (ADR-0131 D9). A bound form clears both. `metadata-core`'s predicate and its two non-door readers are therefore in this diff, beyond the claim's declared file surface; the alternative left the admin read and the save/publish advisory telling the author a bound form is not offered while the doors serve it.
